title: Stop the memo child from re-rendering
prompt: A memo()-wrapped child re-renders on every unrelated parent update because it receives a fresh inline callback each render. Stabilize the callback so the child re-renders only when it has to.
acceptanceCriteria: The child renders once on initial mount (render count shows 1)
Clicking the parent's unrelated "Tick" button does NOT re-render the memo child (render count stays 1)
The child's own button still fires its callback (the last-clicked label updates)
